title: AI Operating System for Consulting Firms
metaDescription: Managed AI operations for consulting firms: connect lead response, engagement kickoff, proposal follow-up and status-report drafting to approved tools.
excerpt: An AI Operating System is the coordination layer that runs the work around the actual consulting. Here is what we install, in what order, and what done looks like.

sections.intro:
Consulting firms often carry operating knowledge across partner memory, documents and chat threads. Lead response, engagement kickoff, proposal follow-up and status reporting can become repeated coordination work.

An AI Operating System (AIOS) connects selected workflows to approved business context and tools. For a consulting firm, that can include eligible lead replies, consistent kickoff tasks, proposal follow-up and review-ready status drafts from agreed sources.

This page explains what we can install, in what order and how the work is measured.
sections.fourCFit:
An AIOS is built on four layers, installed in this order:

  • Context: the system knows the firm, including service lines, client voice, engagement structure and methodology.
  • Connections: the system reaches the approved inbox, calendar, CRM, time, file and project tools.
  • Capabilities: scoped workflows can reply to an inquiry, prepare a discovery pack, draft a status update, follow up a proposal or summarise a call.
  • Cadence: agreed workflows run on a schedule and create a visible run log.

Context and Connections make later Capabilities more useful, while Cadence makes the workflow repeatable.
sections.whatDoneLooksLike:
A completed consulting-firm system can include:

  • A personalized lead-reply workflow connected to your form, inbox and calendar. See 60-Second Lead Response for Consulting Firms.
  • A repeatable engagement kickoff that prepares the agreed intake, deck and statement-of-work touchpoints.
  • Scheduled proposal follow-up that stops when a prospect replies.
  • Review-ready status-update drafts assembled from approved notes, calendar and time data.

The exact workflows and service levels are agreed during scope. You own the prompts, connections and automations built in your accounts.
sections.howWeInstall:
Three phases:

  1. Audit, free, about 10 minutes. Score your AI readiness across the Four Cs and surface high-leverage candidates for your firm. Run the audit.
  2. Install, with a standard target of 10 business days. We wire the agreed tools, capture your firm's voice and methodology, and ship the first scoped workflows.
  3. Operate, ongoing. We monitor, fix and improve the system against the baseline agreed at kickoff. See plans.
sections.expectedResults:
Results are measured against your own kickoff baseline rather than an invented industry average.

  • Lead reply time is measured from enquiry to first response.
  • Proposal follow-up coverage is checked against the agreed cadence.
  • Status-reporting effort is measured before and after the workflow.
  • Human overrides, failures and exceptions remain visible.

Paid plans include the published recovered-hours work guarantee. We do not promise revenue or conversion lift.
sections.faq:
Who owns the system?

You do. Every prompt, connection and automation lives in your accounts. If you stop working with us, you keep the system.

What if something breaks?

Monitoring and fixes are included in managed plans. You get alerts and a clear log of runs and failures.

How soon is the first workflow live?

The standard install target is 10 business days after the required access and business context are available. The actual scope and timeline are agreed before work starts.
